questions.stem: Avian flu (or bird flu) is a virus specific to birds. It causes flu-like symptoms in birds, and it can sometimes pass from birds to humans. There are actually many different kinds of flu viruses, and some only affect certain animals. The bird flu H5N1 is considered very dangerous because it passes so quickly from one bird to another, and it has killed millions of birds worldwide. It can also pass from an infected bird to a human. It killed over 300 people in its last outbreak, and made many more sick. Luckily, the H5N1 virus can't pass from one person to another. Recently, however, there has been a new outbreak of H7N9, another version of the bird flu virus. Again, this virus can't travel from person to person, but doctors are worried that the virus will someday be able to infect more people, which could be a huge disaster. Why isn't the bird flu as dangerous to people as it is to birds?

options.A: It passes from bird to bird very easily.
options.B: It can't pass from person to person.
options.C: It can sometimes pass from birds to humans.

questions.stem: Margaret Thatcher, also known as the Iron Lady, lived from 1925 until 2013. She was a remarkable person in many ways. Thatcher was the first woman to lead a major political party in the United Kingdom. She was also the first and only woman to serve as the Prime Minister of England. She earned her nickname of Iron Lady by being a tough politician who wouldn't compromise. She believed in relaxing laws controlling business and banking as well as reducing the government's role in business. Thatcher brought up strong emotions in people: many loved her and many hated her. While her decisions definitely helped the United Kingdom in the short term, many also believe that she damaged the economy in the long term by giving businesses too much power. However she is remembered, though, she will be remembered for a long time to come as a very powerful woman. Why is Margaret Thatcher called "The Iron Lady?"

options.B: She was the first female Prime Minister.
options.D: Many people loved her, and many people hated her.

When most people think of deserts, they are hot, dry, sandy places. In truth, deserts only need to be dry. A desert is defined as a place that gets less than 25cm of rain per year. Some deserts are actually quite cold. The Gobi desert in northern Asia often has a little snow in the winter, and its temperature can change by as much as 25 degrees Celsius in a single day. The Atacama desert in South America can also get some snow in the winter, and its temperature can change by 40 degrees Celsius or more in a single day. It shouldn't be surprising then that one of the driest places on Earth is also one of the coldest: Antarctica. This cold continent is mostly desert, even though it's covered in ice. It's just that the ice has been there a very long time, in many cases thousands of years. According to this passage, what is true about deserts?

options.B: They are always hot and dry.
